draftNote: 2 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Cuban Noobster (jungle→carry), Xeebs (carry→jungle).

coaching.headline: They put 126266 damage into objectives to our 18178 — and they cashed seven of ten won fights while our seven wins cashed once.
coaching.team: The kill columns say close — Eden had 17, Scarlett 9 — but the map says rout: 11 objective takes to 35 and towers 3-14, because our fight wins were spent nowhere while Khaimera ate the map. Both early trades at 4.4 and 18 were the same shape — we win the bodies, they take Fangtooth across the map — and the death ledger runs twenty-six lines, with Steel's eleven falls alone priced at Fangtooths, Mini Prime, towers and inhibitors. With the carry and offlane pinned in losing lanes, the winning mid and jungle had to rotate, and the file flags them absent at 3.6, 13.9, 16.5, 19.1, 20.5 and 36.3.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 13.9-to-21 stretch decided it — four lost fights around their Fangtooth pit, priced by the file at two Fangtooths, Mini Prime, four towers and the first inhibitor.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Scarlett fought well uphill — 9/5/11 with 64464 mitigated and five kills on Drongo — but the flags land on him twice at the worst times: ahead in the jungle and absent at 20.5 and 36.3, both 0-2s and 0-3s. No magic resist into Iggy & Scorch's 72k magical is the item-screen note.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Steel absorbed a staggering 110,894 mitigated and dealt 18 assists — and died eleven times, with the file pricing nearly every fall at a tower, Fangtooth or inhibitor. A peel tank being the repeated first body into Khaimera and Drongo is the pattern to break: hold the wall for Eden instead of leading into their damage.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Eden put up 17 kills into a lane read 'theirs all game' — and it still could not matter, because the build again skipped Solaris and Nuclear Rounds from Eden's meta core and two wards all game left every fight blind. When the carry is the whole offense, the third core item and river vision are worth more than the eighteenth kill.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Argus. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
ourKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
ourKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
ourKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

ourKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
ourKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
enemyKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate
